summary: Takes a path string, normalizes trailing backslashes via PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer, then returns the result of copying the string through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc. Called by ConfigIniParser.

operations.description: Calls PathTrailingBackslashNormalizer(a1) to normalize trailing backslashes on the input path string.
Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1) to copy the normalized path string into a realloc-managed buffer.
Returns the integer result of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a1).
